SELECT c.*, COALESCE(c.manual_cost,c.site_cost,c.common_cost,c.receipt_cost,c.standard_cost) unit_cost, CASE WHEN c.manual_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'MANUAL' WHEN c.site_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'SITE_PRICE' WHEN c.common_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMMON_PRICE' WHEN c.receipt_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'RECEIPT' WHEN c.standard_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'STANDARD' END cost_source, CASE WHEN c.manual_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.manual_date WHEN c.site_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.site_date WHEN c.common_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.common_date WHEN c.receipt_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.receipt_date WHEN c.standard_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.standard_date END cost_source_date, COALESCE(c.site_cost,c.common_cost,c.receipt_cost,c.standard_cost) auto_unit_cost, CASE WHEN c.site_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'SITE_PRICE' WHEN c.common_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMMON_PRICE' WHEN c.receipt_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'RECEIPT' WHEN c.standard_cost IS NOT NULL THEN 'STANDARD' END auto_source, CASE WHEN c.site_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.site_date WHEN c.common_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.common_date WHEN c.receipt_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.receipt_date WHEN c.standard_cost IS NOT NULL THEN c.standard_date END auto_source_date FROM ( SELECT q.*,pr.product_name price_product_name, (SELECT h.purchase_price FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price h JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=h.supplier_offer_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site a ON a.supplier_site_id=o.supplier_site_id WHERE a.account_id=q.account_id AND a.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.supplier_product_id=q.price_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.supplier_price_id DESC LIMIT 1) /NULLIF(pr.base_qty,0)* site_cost, (SELECT DATE(h.effective_from) FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price h JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=h.supplier_offer_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site a ON a.supplier_site_id=o.supplier_site_id WHERE a.account_id=q.account_id AND a.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.supplier_product_id=q.price_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.supplier_price_id DESC LIMIT 1) site_date, (SELECT h.purchase_price FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history h WHERE h.supplier_product_id=q.price_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.price_history_id DESC LIMIT 1) /NULLIF(pr.base_qty,0)* common_cost, (SELECT DATE(h.effective_from) FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history h WHERE h.supplier_product_id=q.price_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.price_history_id DESC LIMIT 1) common_date FROM ( SELECT ai.account_id,ai.ingredient_id,ai.base_unit, COALESCE( (SELECT l.supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=ai.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id AND l.supplier_product_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT i.supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item i JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po ON po.purchase_order_id=i.purchase_order_id WHERE po.account_id=ai.account_id AND i.source_ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id AND i.supplier_product_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY po.ordered_at DESC,po.purchase_order_id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT sp.supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product sp WHERE sp.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id AND sp.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site a ON a.supplier_site_id=o.supplier_site_id WHERE a.account_id=ai.account_id AND a.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.supplier_product_id=sp.supplier_product_id) DESC, sp.supplier_product_id LIMIT 1)) price_product_id, CASE WHEN pc.source_type='MANUAL' AND pc.unit_cost>0 THEN pc.unit_cost* END manual_cost, DATE(pc.confirmed_at) manual_date, CASE WHEN stock.average_cost>0 THEN stock.average_cost WHEN lot.receipt_unit_cost>0 THEN lot.receipt_unit_cost END receipt_cost, CASE WHEN stock.average_cost>0 THEN DATE(stock.last_movement_at) WHEN lot.receipt_unit_cost>0 THEN lot.received_date END receipt_date, (SELECT CASE WHEN im.standard_unit_cost>0 THEN im.standard_unit_cost* END FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im WHERE im.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id OR (im.ingredient_name_std=COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw) AND im.standard_unit_cost>0) ORDER BY im.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id DESC,im.ingredient_id LIMIT 1) standard_cost, (SELECT DATE(COALESCE(im.standard_cost_mod_at,im.mod_at,im.created_at)) FROM the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master im WHERE im.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id OR (im.ingredient_name_std=COALESCE(ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw) AND im.standard_unit_cost>0) ORDER BY im.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id DESC,im.ingredient_id LIMIT 1) standard_date FROM the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_planning_cost pc ON pc.planning_cost_id=( SELECT h.planning_cost_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_planning_cost h WHERE h.account_id=ai.account_id AND h.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id ORDER BY h.planning_cost_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT b.account_id,b.ingredient_id,SUM(b.inventory_amount)/NULLIF(SUM(b.current_base_qty),0) average_cost,MAX(b.last_movement_at) last_movement_at FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance b WHERE b.current_base_qty>0 AND b.average_unit_cost>0 AND b.account_id=#{account_id} GROUP BY b.account_id,b.ingredient_id ) stock ON stock.account_id=ai.account_id AND stock.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=ai.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=ai.ingredient_id AND l.receipt_unit_cost>0 ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE ai.active_yn='Y' AND ai.account_id=#{account_id} ) q LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product pr ON pr.supplier_product_id=q.price_product_id ) c

SELECT m.menu_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.ingredient_id)>0 AND COUNT(r.cost)=COUNT(r.ingredient_id) THEN ROUND(SUM(r.cost),4) END menu_cost_per_person, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.ingredient_id)>0 AND COUNT(r.cost)=COUNT(r.ingredient_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END menu_cost_complete, CASE WHEN COUNT(r.ingredient_id)=0 THEN '레시피 없음' ELSE GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN r.cost IS NULL THEN CONCAT(r.ingredient_name,': 단가 미등록') END SEPARATOR ', ') END menu_cost_reason FROM the_full_order.tb_menu_master m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hr.menu_id,hr.ingredient_id,COALESCE(hi.ingredient_name_std,hr.ingredient_name_raw,hr.ingredient_id) ingredient_name, CASE WHEN hr.review_flag=0 THEN hr.qty_per_person*COALESCE( pp.unit_cost*,
(SELECT COALESCE( (SELECT h.purchase_price FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price h JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=h.supplier_offer_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site a ON a.supplier_site_id=o.supplier_site_id WHERE a.account_id=#{account_id} AND a.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.supplier_product_id=sp.supplier_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.supplier_price_id DESC LIMIT 1), (SELECT h.purchase_price FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_price_history h WHERE h.supplier_product_id=sp.supplier_product_id AND h.purchase_price>0 ORDER BY ,h.effective_from DESC,h.price_history_id DESC LIMIT 1)) /NULLIF(sp.base_qty,0)* FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product sp WHERE sp.ingredient_id=hr.ingredient_id AND sp.active_yn='Y' ORDER BY EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site a ON a.supplier_site_id=o.supplier_site_id WHERE a.account_id=#{account_id} AND a.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.supplier_product_id=sp.supplier_product_id) DESC, sp.supplier_product_id LIMIT 1), CASE WHEN hi.standard_unit_cost>0 THEN hi.standard_unit_cost* END) END cost FROM the_full_order.tb_recipe_detail hr LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master hi ON hi.ingredient_id=hr.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN () pp ON pp.account_id=#{account_id} AND pp.ingredient_id=hr.ingredient_id ) r ON r.menu_id=m.menu_id WHERE m.del_yn='N' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_menu_master am WHERE am.account_id=#{account_id} AND am.menu_id=m.menu_id AND am.del_yn='N') GROUP BY m.menu_id

SELECT pp.account_id,pp.ingredient_id,pp.base_unit,pp.auto_source,pp.auto_unit_cost,pp.auto_source_date, pp.manual_cost,pp.manual_date,pp.unit_cost,pp.cost_source FROM () pp WHERE pp.account_id=#{account_id} AND pp.ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id}
mapper.sql: SELECT x.*, CASE WHEN x.review_flag=0 AND x.qty_per_person>0 AND x.unit_cost>0 THEN x.qty_per_person*x.unit_cost END cost_per_person, CASE WHEN x.review_flag<>0 OR x.qty_per_person IS NULL THEN '단위 확인' WHEN x.unit_cost IS NULL OR x.unit_cost<=0 THEN '단가 미등록' WHEN x.qty_per_person<=0 THEN '사용량 확인' END missing_reason FROM ( SELECT rd.account_recipe_detail_id,rd.account_id,rd.menu_id,rd.ingredient_id,rd.ingredient_name_raw ingredient_name,rd.review_flag, COALESCE(pp.base_unit,rd.base_unit) base_unit,pp.unit_cost,pp.cost_source,pp.cost_source_date, CASE WHEN pp.base_unit IS NULL OR LOWER(rd.base_unit)=LOWER(pp.base_unit) THEN rd.qty_per_person WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='kg' AND LOWER(pp.base_unit)='g') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='l' AND LOWER(pp.base_unit)='ml') THEN rd.qty_per_person*1000 WHEN (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='g' AND LOWER(pp.base_unit)='kg') OR (LOWER(rd.base_unit)='ml' AND LOWER(pp.base_unit)='l') THEN rd.qty_per_person/1000 END qty_per_person FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd LEFT JOIN () pp ON pp.account_id=rd.account_id AND pp.ingredient_id=rd.ingredient_id WHERE rd.account_id=#{account_id} ) x
